title: Tech Note: Exploring 4D Portal’s Postcard Portlet

historical_commentary.text: 4D Portal has been discontinued, making the specific Postcard portlet obsolete; the general "send-a-digital-postcard" concept it implements has been largely displaced by modern social media sharing and messaging apps, so this note is now chiefly of historical interest.
related_updates: 4D Portal has been discontinued; social media and messaging apps have largely displaced the standalone digital-postcard-sharing use case
